# Our Leaders

Perceptyx is a unique company and requires the same in its leadership team. Each member draws upon unique and vital skills in a separate area of experience and specific expertise. It is this “symphony of skills” that has taken Perceptyx from just a great idea into a great company.

## Leadership Team

### Ross Wainwright

#### Chief Executive Officer

### Ross Wainwright

#### Chief Executive Officer

Ross Wainwright is Chief Executive Officer of Perceptyx, where he leads company strategy and daily business operations. In this role, Ross is dedicated to helping large enterprises transform their employee experience through AI-powered employee listening and action that accelerates key business outcomes.

Ross brings to Perceptyx a proven 30-year record of fast-tracking ideas that disrupt existing markets and deliver incremental business value to customers. Most recently, he was CEO at Alida, a global leader in community insights. While at Alida, Wainwright led a transformation of the business, including a full company rebrand, expanding its go-to-market strategy and market positioning, and delivering over 20 new products and 190 enhancements to its Total Experience Management Platform.

During Ross’s tenure with Alida, the company was repeatedly recognized for its innovation and people-first culture, including being named as A Great Place to Work, a Best Workplace in Canada, and one of The Best Workplaces™ for Today’s Youth. Alida was also recognized by Comparably for “Best Company Outlook,” “Best Company Culture,” “Best CEO,” “Best CEO for Women,” and “Best Company for Diversity” among small/mid-sized companies in North America.

Prior to Alida, Wainwright was CEO of Americas for Dimension Data/NTT and spent 15 years in progressive executive leadership roles at SAP, including Chief Customer Officer for the S/4Hana Cloud business unit and Global Head of Financial Services. Early career experience includes more than 8 years with PTC in various leadership positions.

Wainwright graduated from Western University with an undergraduate degree in English History and a minor in business.

### Mary Poppen

#### Chief Customer Officer

### Mary Poppen

#### Chief Customer Officer

Mary Poppen is a recognized leader in Employee Experience (EX), Customer Experience (CX), and AI-driven business transformation. Trained as an Industrial and Organizational Psychologist, she has spent more than two decades helping organizations transform through the intersection of people, process, and technology.

As an early pioneer in the SaaS era, Mary became one of the first Chief Customer Officers in B2B HR technology, helping define the modern customer success and post-sale growth function. Throughout her career, she has held executive leadership, advisory, and operational roles across some of the world’s leading HR technology and customer experience organizations, driving measurable business impact through customer-centric innovation.

Today, Mary is widely regarded as a leading voice in B2B technology, helping organizations optimize customer outcomes, elevate employee engagement, and harness artificial intelligence to accelerate organizational performance and growth.

### Lisa Sterling

#### Chief People Officer

### Lisa Sterling

#### Chief People Officer

Lisa Sterling is a forward-thinking, engaging leader who has been disrupting the business and HR landscape to create cultural and organizational for the past 20 years. As a Chief Administrative, HR, Culture, and People Officer, as well as an HCM product expert, Lisa led one of the most radical cultural transformations for a fast-growing, technology company. Now with Perceptyx she is leading the growth and transformation of our people and culture, as well as serving as a thought leader to HR and Tech professionals within global organizations.

### Stephen Foster

#### Chief Revenue Officer

### Stephen Foster

#### Chief Revenue Officer

Stephen Foster is the Chief Revenue Officer at Perceptyx, where he leads a team of global account executives, solution consultants, and business development representatives focused on acquiring and expanding large enterprise customers. A collaborative leader with a proven track record of successfully aligning sales strategy and execution to company goals, Stephen is passionate about building high-performance teams that deliver exceptional results.

Stephen brings to Perceptyx more than 15 years of progressive sales and go-to-market (GTM) leadership, including several roles within the employee experience (EX) and customer experience (CX) industries. Most recently serving as CRO with Authenticom, Stephen led sales and customer success efforts for the company’s flagship products, enabling B2B companies to integrate and manage their customers' data ecosystems seamlessly.

Previous sales leadership roles include tenure with human experience platform, Press Ganey/Forsta, where he achieved a 1.5x year-over-year revenue increase; community research platform, Alida, where he increased sales revenues 6x over three years by building and scaling multiple greenfield teams; CX & EX Technology company, Ibex, where he built a powerful sales engine across North America and Europe, helping to fuel their IPO in 2020; and establishing Medallia’s CX and EX platform in Canada in 2015, supporting their 2019 IPO.

Based in Burlington, Ontario, Stephen balances work with a love of golf, guitar, and BBQ. A devoted family man, Stephen is supported by his wife, Aileen, and their two beautiful children, William and Sienna.

### Patricia Curulla

#### Chief Finance Officer

### Patricia Curulla

#### Chief Finance Officer

Patricia Curulla leads Perceptyx's financial strategy and operations as Chief Financial Officer, a role she assumed after six years of progressive leadership within the company. She joined Perceptyx in April 2020 as Director of Finance, shortly following the organization's investment from TCV, and advanced through successive senior positions, including Vice President of Finance & Operations and Interim CFO, before being appointed to the C-suite as permanent CFO in 2026.

Patty built and led the teams responsible for Financial Planning and Analysis, Corporate Finance, Treasury, Accounting, and Finance Operations, establishing the infrastructure that has supported Perceptyx's growth. During her tenure, she has guided the company through six acquisitions, including Humu, Cultivate, Waggl, CultureIQ, Lyceum, and the employee insights business of Kantar. Her work has delivered sustained double-digit revenue growth, consistent positive EBITDA, and expansion into new international markets.

Before joining Perceptyx, Patty served as Director of Finance at Healthline Media in San Francisco, where she managed Finance, Facilities, and IT. Earlier in her career, she held roles at Golub Capital and JPMorgan Chase & Co. in Chicago, where she focused on sponsor finance, executing transactions in partnership with private equity firms and developing deep expertise in credit underwriting

Patty holds an MBA from the Haas School of Business at the University of California, Berkeley and a BA in Economics from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. She currently resides in the suburbs of Chicago.

### Christopher Chadwick

#### Chief Strategy Officer

### Christopher Chadwick

#### Chief Strategy Officer

Christopher Chadwick is the Chief Strategy Officer at Perceptyx, where he manages several strategic functions spanning Field Operations, Value Engineering, GTM strategy, and Corporate Development. As a customer-centric leader with a focus on operational excellence and revenue growth, Christopher is passionate about building high performing organizations that deliver sustainable value.

Over the course of his career as a management consultant and technology executive, Christopher has held leadership positions at multinationals such as SAP, Box, and BlackBerry – most recently serving as a Global Vice President at Trellix and Senior Vice President at Alida, where he led a multi-year transformation focused on GTM strategy and consolidation. His deep experience scaling organizations via both organic growth and strategic M&A has enabled him to transform companies while maximizing value across the enterprise.

Outside of Perceptyx Christopher remains active in the non-profit community as a youth mentor and serves as a startup advisor to tech entrepreneurs. He obtained an honours degree from the University of Toronto and holds a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from the Richard Ivey School of Business at Western University.

### JD Peterson

#### Chief Marketing Officer

### JD Peterson

#### Chief Marketing Officer

JD Peterson is a seasoned B2B SaaS executive with over two decades of experience driving growth, developing brands, and unlocking innovation in the technology sector. JD brings a wealth of expertise in go-to-market strategies and organizational leadership, and is a veteran of the HR Technology space.

Most recently, JD served as CEO of Mathison, where he led the charge in helping companies build more equitable and inclusive workplaces through innovative technology and data-driven insights. Prior to Mathison, JD served as Chief Growth Officer at Culture Amp, where he helped scale the business into a global leader in employee experience. During his tenure, JD was responsible for all aspects of Go-To-Market including Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, and Revenue Operations.

Throughout his career, JD has held pivotal roles at several high-growth companies. He served as Vice President of Marketing at Zendesk, where he played a crucial role in scaling the company's global presence and transforming from a small startup to a successful public company. At Marketo, he was Vice President of Products, contributing to the development of their award winning marketing automation solutions. His leadership journey also includes executive positions at Trello, and Gatsby, where he consistently focused on building customer-centric teams and driving sustainable growth.

Beyond his executive roles, JD is an active startup advisor and investor, particularly through his involvement with GTMfund. His passion for fostering inclusive workplaces and mentoring emerging leaders underscores his commitment to creating impactful organizational cultures.

JD holds a Bachelor’s degree from Indiana University and resides in the San Francisco Bay Area.

### Joseph Freed

#### Chief Product Officer

### Joseph Freed

#### Chief Product Officer

Joseph Freed is the Chief Product Officer at Perceptyx, where he leads the company’s product strategy, innovation, and execution across its enterprise-grade Employee Experience (EX) platform. In this role, Joseph oversees a comprehensive portfolio of AI-powered products designed to help large organizations foster a thriving employee culture and drive measurable business outcomes. He is responsible for shaping Perceptyx’s product vision, aligning product development with the company’s strategic goals, and ensuring the successful delivery of innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of Fortune 500 clients. Joseph’s leadership extends to cross-functional collaboration across engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success teams, ensuring that Perceptyx maintains its competitive edge in the HR technology space.

Before joining Perceptyx, Joseph was the Co-founder and CEO of Cultivate, a venture-backed AI coaching and analytics platform, which was acquired by Perceptyx in 2022. During his tenure at Cultivate, he led the company from ideation to successful product launch, securing strategic partnerships and scaling the business to serve global enterprise customers. His entrepreneurial journey also includes serving as an Entrepreneur in Residence at Samsung NEXT and as Co-founder and CEO of an edtech startup incubated at the Education Design Studio at the University of Pennsylvania.

With a deep passion for product management and innovation, Joseph has held multiple leadership roles in product management across various industries. He has also shared his expertise as a lecturer of software product management at UC Berkeley Extension and is an active startup advisor, mentoring the next generation of product leaders.

Joseph holds a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering from Pennsylvania State University and an MBA from New York University Stern School of Business.

### David Hollady

#### General Counsel, Data Privacy Officer

### David Hollady

#### General Counsel, Data Privacy Officer

Currently serving as General Counsel for Perceptyx, Hollady brings more than a decade of legal and operations expertise to the organization. His track record encompasses building legal commercial teams, implementing comprehensive privacy programs, managing complex M&A transactions, and overseeing crucial fundraising activities.

Prior to Perceptyx, Hollady's career trajectory was marked by increasingly strategic roles at companies experiencing significant growth and transformation. As Head of Legal and HumanResources at Lever, Hollady successfully managed the company's $60 million Series D financing round and subsequent tender offer. His leadership extended beyond traditional legal functions to include the development of a privacy program that supported more than 6,000 customers across 30 countries, ensuring compliance with complex international regulations including GDPR, CCPA, and PIPEDA.

Following Lever’s successful acquisition by Employ, David joined the new organization as Head of Legal and DPO, overseeing legal, compliance, and contract operations.

Hollady's commitment to legal excellence and professional development is evidenced by his service on the Content Scope Committee of the National Conference of Bar Examiners, where he helped shape the future of the legal profession's qualifying examination. He maintains active involvement in the legal technology community as a charter member of TechGC, an invitation-only peer community for general counsels who work in the technology sector.

Hollady holds IAPP CIPP/E and CIPM certifications, as well as an MBA from the University of California, Berkeley's Haas School of Business, and a law degree from New England Law \| Boston.

## Our Board Members

### John Borland

#### Co-Founder \| Former CEO \| Board Member

### John Borland

#### Co-Founder \| Former CEO \| Board Member

John Borland is a co-founder of Perceptyx and currently sits on the Board of Directors. He serves as the company’s historian and is a passionate advocate for Perceptyx’s mission to be trusted by the world’s leading enterprises and help create environments where both people and organizations can thrive.

After co-founding Perceptyx in 2003, John worked in nearly every area of the company’s business. Capping more than two decades of experience in the employee listening industry, John served as Perceptyx’s CEO from 2017 to 2025. During his tenure, the company completed five successful acquisitions, expanded its customer base to include more than 600 large enterprises – including 30% of the Fortune 100 – and executed a significant platform evolution to become a global leader in the employee experience market.

A native Californian, John and his wife have been married for 27 years and have five children. In his free time, John enjoys relaxing on the water with family and friends or building something new in his workshop. He holds a bachelor’s degree in business administration and management from California Polytechnic State University.

### Tim McAdam

#### Board Member \| TCV

### Tim McAdam

#### Board Member \| TCV

Tim joined TCV in 2010 and focuses on investments in the enterprise software, security, and tech-enabled services markets. He is currently involved with investments in Aviatrix, GitLab (NASDAQ: GTLB), Nasuni, OneTrust, Oversight, Perceptyx, and Vectra. He was formerly involved with investments in Alarm.com (NASDAQ: ALRM), Avalara (NYSE: AVLR), Certinia (fka FinancialForce), Rapid7 (NASDAQ: RPD), Silver Peak (acquired by HPE), Splunk (NASDAQ: SPLK), Talend and TOA Technologies (acquired by Oracle).

Tim was previously a partner at Trinity Ventures, a leading early- to mid-stage venture capital firm, where he focused on investments in the software and security sectors. Prior to Trinity, Tim was a vice president at GTCR in Chicago. He started his career in the early 1990s at TA Associates in Boston.

### Dave Eichler

#### Board Member \| TCV

### Dave Eichler

#### Board Member \| TCV

David joined TCV in 2013 and currently leads Portfolio Optimization across the TCV portfolio. Prior to his current role, he focused on investments in B2B software, with a specific focus on edtech, fintech, HR tech, and vertical market software. He is currently involved with investments in Built, Employment Hero, HireVue, Nerdy, Newsela, OneSource Virtual, Perceptyx and Watermark. David was formerly involved with investments in Avalara, Humu, LinkedIn and Tastyworks.

David spent a year away from TCV (2016-2017), working at HireVue in Utah, where he helped develop the company’s sales & marketing strategy. Prior to TCV, David worked at The Blackstone Group in the Bay Area focusing on Technology M&A. He started his career at Lighthouse Capital Partners, a venture debt provider.

### Steve Winter

#### Board Member

### Steve Winter

#### Board Member

Steve joined the Perceptyx Board in 2025 and provides strategic perspective to help the company accelerate innovation, scale globally, and further solidify its position as the definitive leader in the Employee Experience (EX) market.

Winter also currently serves as an Operations Advisor to Advent International, one of the world’s largest private equity firms, and holds board positions with Ziosk and Medius, and serves as a Board Advisor to Prometheus Group and Syspro.

Now retired as the former Chief Revenue Officer of Coupa Software, Steve was responsible for driving the company’s strategy and execution on all revenue-connected aspects of the business. During Steve’s tenure, the company had a successful IPO and continued to experience explosive, year-over-year growth. Prior to Coupa, Steve was Executive Vice President of Worldwide Sales and Operations at Marketo, where he led the expansion from SMB to Enterprise.

A strategic executive with more than 30 years of experience, Steve previously held a number of key global sales and executive leadership positions at SAP and PeopleSoft.

Steve was a founding partner of Sagebrook Technology Partners, where he focused on investment portfolio management, technology acquisitions, and organizational development from 1999 to 2003. In addition to his time with Sagebrook, Steve also served as interim CEO/president of Isochron Data Corporation from July 2000 through June 2001.

Steve holds a bachelor’s degree in business administration of computer information systems from Georgia State University.
